svg.text: Cut 350 mm of 20 x 20 x 1.5 mm square tube; square and deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure from the foot end (the end that takes the fixed foot):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bracket bolt hole 5.5 mm at 130 mm, top and bottom walls;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: locking pin hole 6.5 mm at 320 mm, top and bottom walls.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill each pair straight through both walls in a drill stand so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press a 20 x 20 tube insert with an M10 nut into the foot end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the inner tube slides into the other end with 0.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clearance; the pin goes through both tubes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the inner tube slides the full length without binding.
